facets.description: Attachments: the flat 10MB client check ignores max_attachment_size_kb, so the client wrongly rejects or accepts files compared with the server limit.
Images that the server's 5-pass downsize loop can't bring under max_image_size_kb pass the 10MB client check, then the server rejects them.
The file_too_large error message always reports 10MB (10240 KB) instead of the real configured limit (validator alert / 413 handler).
